"""One pick-and-place step: measure -> screen orientation -> act -> re-measure."""
import sys, json, numpy as np, robot
from robot import target, tools, handoff, ToolRefused
from ora_lib import current, Point, Direction
from dolls import measure_dolls
from kine import axes, link6_for_jaw_centre, grip_point

SLOT_Y = -0.32
SLOTX = {0: -0.24, 1: -0.12, 2: 0.0, 3: 0.12, 4: 0.24}   # size rank -> world x (smallest .. largest)
ARM = {0: "left", 1: "right", 2: "left", 3: "right", 4: "right"}
FRAC = 0.42
TRANSFER_DZ = 0.30          # link6 height above table while transferring
PREGRASP_DZ = 0.06
RETREAT_DZ = 0.08
TOL_M = 0.012
YAWS = [112.5, 90.0, 0.0, 135.0, 45.0]

def log(**kw):
    print(json.dumps(kw, default=str))

def near(meas, x, y, rad=0.06):
    best = None
    for d in meas["all"]:
        r = ((d["cx"]-x)**2 + (d["cy"]-y)**2) ** 0.5
        if r < rad and (best is None or r < best[0]):
            best = (r, d)
    return best[1] if best else None

def mv(arm, pos, yaw, interaction, speed=None, slow=False, dry=False):
    appr, jaw = axes(yaw)
    t = target(position=Point([float(v) for v in pos], "world"),
               approach=Direction([float(v) for v in appr], "world"),
               jaw_line=Direction([float(v) for v in jaw], "world"),
               interaction=interaction)
    kw = dict(targets={arm: t})
    if speed: kw["speed"] = speed
    if slow: kw["slow_approaching"] = True
    if dry: kw["dry_run"] = True
    return tools.move_pose(**kw)

def check(r, name):
    log(move=name, ok=r.ok, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, stage=r.failure_stage,
        target_error_m=None if r.target_error_m is None else round(float(r.target_error_m), 5))
    return r.ok

def main(rank):
    arm = ARM[rank]
    meas = measure_dolls(); tz = meas["table_z"]
    if len(meas["dolls"]) != 5:
        handoff("not five dolls visible", n=len(meas["dolls"]),
                blobs=[(round(d["cx"],3), round(d["cy"],3), round(d["h"],3)) for d in meas["all"]])
    d = meas["dolls"][rank]
    pick_l6 = link6_for_jaw_centre(grip_point(d, tz, FRAC))
    slot_l6 = np.array([SLOTX[rank], SLOT_Y, pick_l6[2]])
    P = dict(pregrasp=pick_l6 + [0, 0, PREGRASP_DZ], grasp=pick_l6,
             lift=np.array([pick_l6[0], pick_l6[1], tz + TRANSFER_DZ]),
             over=np.array([slot_l6[0], slot_l6[1], tz + TRANSFER_DZ]),
             place=slot_l6, retreat=slot_l6 + [0, 0, RETREAT_DZ])
    log(plan=dict(rank=rank, arm=arm, doll_h=round(d["h"], 4), pick_xy=[round(d["cx"],4), round(d["cy"],4)],
                  slot=[SLOTX[rank], SLOT_Y], pick_l6=np.round(pick_l6,4).tolist(),
                  slot_l6=np.round(slot_l6,4).tolist()))
    seq = ["pregrasp", "grasp", "lift", "over", "place", "retreat"]
    yaw = None
    for y in YAWS:
        pv = [__import__("kine").pose_vec(P[n], jaw_line=axes(y)[1]) for n in seq]
        res = robot.query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=pv, interaction="precision")
        ok = [bool(rr.get("reachable")) for rr in res["results"]]
        log(screen=dict(yaw=y, ok=ok))
        if all(ok):
            yaw = y; break
    if yaw is None:
        handoff("no reachable jaw orientation", arm=arm, rank=rank)
    log(chosen_yaw=yaw)

    def act(name, label, speed, slow):
        r = mv(arm, P[name], yaw, label, speed, slow)
        if not check(r, name):
            handoff("move failed", name=name, failure=r.failure_code, status=r.status, stage=r.failure_stage)
        tcp = np.asarray(current().pose(arm).position.xyz, float)
        miss = float(np.linalg.norm(tcp - P[name]))
        log(endpoint=dict(name=name, miss_m=round(miss, 5)))
        if miss > TOL_M:
            handoff("endpoint missed", name=name, miss_m=miss, tol=TOL_M)

    act("pregrasp", "free_space", None, False)
    act("grasp", "precision", "normal", True)
    r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"})
    log(close=dict(ok=r.ok, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code,
                   measured_opening=getattr(r, "measured_opening", None),
                   measured_aperture_mm=getattr(r, "measured_aperture_mm", None)))
    act("lift", "precision", "careful", False)

    m2 = measure_dolls()
    hit = near(m2, d["cx"], d["cy"])
    log(after_lift=dict(found=None if hit is None else {k: round(hit[k],4) for k in ("cx","cy","h","base_z")},
                        table_z=round(tz,4)))
    if hit is not None and hit["base_z"] < tz + 0.05:
        handoff("doll did not leave the table", doll=rank, base_z=hit["base_z"], table_z=tz)

    act("over", "free_space", "normal", False)
    act("place", "precision", "normal", True)
    r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
    log(open=dict(ok=r.ok, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code))
    act("retreat", "free_space", "normal", False)

    m3 = measure_dolls()
    hit = near(m3, slot_l6[0], SLOT_Y, 0.08)
    log(after_place=dict(found=None if hit is None else {k: round(hit[k],4) for k in ("cx","cy","h","base_z","wx","wy")},
                         n_dolls=len(m3["dolls"]),
                         row=[(round(x["cx"],3), round(x["cy"],3), round(x["h"],3)) for x in m3["dolls"]]))
    print("DONE rank=%d slot_x=%.2f arm=%s yaw=%g" % (rank, SLOTX[rank], arm, yaw))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main(int(sys.argv[1]))
    except ToolRefused as e:
        handoff("tool refused", name=e.name, code=e.code, answer=e.answer)

def verify_slot(camera, slot_x, slot_y, h_exp, tz, tag):

                     found=[{k: round(d[k],4) for k in ("cx","cy","h","base_z")} for d in near])})
    if not near: return dict(ok=False)
    d = near[0]
    err = ((d["cx"]-slot_x)**2+(d["cy"]-slot_y)**2)**0.5
    return dict(ok=bool(err < 0.035), err_m=round(err,4), h=round(d["h"],4))

        log(move=name, ok=r.ok, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
        if not r.ok:

from robot import target, tools, handoff, ToolRefused

FRAC = 0.42
PREGRASP_DZ = 0.06
RETREAT_DZ = 0.15
TOL_M = 0.012
GRASP_TOL_M = 0.02          # a contact stop this close to the grasp pose is still a usable grasp
YAWS = [112.5, 90.0, 0.0, 135.0, 45.0]
TRANSFER_DZS = [0.30, 0.33, 0.27, 0.36]

def log(**kw):
    print(json.dumps(kw, default=str))

def comp(m, x, y, rad):
    return sorted([d for d in m["all"] if ((d["cx"]-x)**2+(d["cy"]-y)**2)**0.5 < rad],
                  key=lambda d: ((d["cx"]-x)**2+(d["cy"]-y)**2))

def mv(arm, pos, yaw, interaction, speed=None, slow=False, contact=False, dry=False):
    appr, jaw = axes(yaw)
    t = target(position=Point([float(v) for v in pos], "world"),
               approach=Direction([float(v) for v in appr], "world"),
               jaw_line=Direction([float(v) for v in jaw], "world"),
               interaction=interaction)
    kw = dict(targets={arm: t})
    if speed: kw["speed"] = speed
    if slow: kw["slow_approaching"] = True
    if contact: kw["expect_contact"] = True
    if dry: kw["dry_run"] = True
    return tools.move_pose(**kw)

def check_placed(inv, tz, tag):
    """Verify every slot already recorded as placed, from the head camera."""
    m = measure_dolls()
    out = {}
    for k, rec in inv["placed"].items():
        h = inv["dolls"][k]["h"]
        cand = [d for d in m["all"] if d["base_z"] < tz+0.06 and 0.5*h < d["h"] < 1.8*h+0.02]
        near = comp({"all": cand}, rec["slot"][0], rec["slot"][1], 0.06)
        out[k] = None if not near else dict(
            cx=round(near[0]["cx"],4), cy=round(near[0]["cy"],4), h=round(near[0]["h"],4),
            err=round(float(((near[0]["cx"]-rec["slot"][0])**2+(near[0]["cy"]-rec["slot"][1])**2)**0.5),4))
    log(**{tag: dict(row=out)})
    return out

    arm = ARM[rank]
    inv = json.load(open("/work/inventory.json"))
    meas = measure_dolls(); tz = meas["table_z"]
    check_placed(inv, tz, "row_before")
    ref = inv["dolls"][str(rank)]
    cand = comp(meas, ref["cx"], ref["cy"], 0.05)
    cand = [x for x in cand if 0.7*ref["h"] < x["h"] < 1.4*ref["h"]+0.005]
    log(find=dict(ref=ref, cand=[{k: round(x[k],4) for k in ("cx","cy","h")} for x in cand]))
    if not cand:
        handoff("rank doll not found", rank=rank)
    d = cand[0]
    plan_grasp_z = tz + FRAC*d["h"] + 0.1501
    pick_l6 = np.array([d["cx"], d["cy"], plan_grasp_z])
    pregrasp = pick_l6 + [0,0,PREGRASP_DZ]
    slot_xyz = np.array([SLOTX[rank], SLOT_Y])

    yaw = None
    for y in YAWS:

                 pose_vec(np.array([pick_l6[0], pick_l6[1], tz+0.30]), jaw_line=axes(y)[1]),
                 pose_vec(np.array([slot_xyz[0], slot_xyz[1], tz+0.30]), jaw_line=axes(y)[1]),
                 pose_vec(np.array([slot_xyz[0], slot_xyz[1], plan_grasp_z]), jaw_line=axes(y)[1])]
        res = robot.query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=poses, interaction="precision")
        ok = [bool(rr.get("reachable")) for rr in res["results"]]
        log(screen=dict(yaw=y, ok=ok))
        if all(ok):
            yaw = y; break
    if yaw is None:

    log(plan=dict(rank=rank, arm=arm, h=round(d["h"],4), pick=np.round(pick_l6,4).tolist(),
                  slot=np.round(slot_xyz,4).tolist(), yaw=yaw))

    log(move=dict(name="pregrasp", ok=r.ok, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code))
    if not r.ok: handoff("pregrasp failed", failure=r.failure_code)
    r = mv(arm, pick_l6, yaw, "precision", "normal", True)
    log(move=dict(name="grasp", ok=r.ok, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m))

    appr, jaw = axes(yaw)

               approach=Direction([float(v) for v in appr], "world"),

    m = measure_dolls()

        near = comp({"all": cand}, rec["slot"][0], rec["slot"][1], 0.06)

            err=round(float(((near[0]["cx"]-rec["slot"][0])**2+(near[0]["cy"]-rec["slot"][1])**2)**0.5),4))
